task.instruction: Advise whether the county should reserve all 12 mobile generators today, buy a 14-day option on four units while collecting comparison data, or cancel. Give one decision, evidence, a counter-risk, and a release trigger. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: Across 20 outages, the eight-unit pilot reduced median restoration from 140 to 78 minutes; the dispatcher rota changed on the pilot start date.
Eleven of 12 hookups met the 20-minute target; the twelfth took 27 minutes; safety incidents were zero against a zero-incident limit.
The emergency manager owns dispatch; three of three transfer drills passed; retrieval takes 18 minutes; the 30-day forecast contains 12 outage-risk nights.
A four-unit option lasts 14 days, preserves comparison nights, and costs $18,000. Reserving 12 units costs $96,000 for six months and removes the comparison; cancellation forfeits availability.
At a refrigerated depot, six backup units cut recovery from 95 to 54 minutes while the call tree changed; a seven-day rental option remained available.
A drainage fleet completed 9 of 10 starts inside 15 minutes, named a dispatch lead, passed three exercises, and faced eight forecast storm nights.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-04-16 — Decision: Rent two depot units for seven days before contracting the fleet. Reason: Recovery improved 41 minutes while the call tree changed. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-01].
2026-05-14 — Decision: Stage the drainage fleet under its named dispatch lead. Reason: Nine timely starts, three exercises, and eight storm nights meet readiness. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-04-16 — Decision: Contract the depot fleet after assigning recovery ownership. Reason: A 41-minute gain and available units support continuity despite the changed call tree. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-01].
2026-05-14 — Decision: Rehearse one storm deployment before staging all pumps. Reason: One late start among ten leaves a bounded timing uncertainty. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-04-16 — Decision: Rent two depot units for seven days before contracting the fleet. Reason: Recovery improved 41 minutes while the call tree changed, so attribution remains open. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-01].
2026-05-14 — Decision: Rehearse one storm deployment before staging all pumps. Reason: One late start among ten leaves a bounded timing uncertainty before commitment. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-04-16 — Decision: Contract the depot fleet under an assigned recovery lead. Reason: A 41-minute gain and available units support operational continuity. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-01].
2026-05-14 — Decision: Stage the drainage fleet under its named dispatch lead. Reason: Nine timely starts, three exercises, and eight storm nights meet readiness. Evidence: [rb-s1d-prior-02].
